adversarial_review.check: Every high-cutoff row is finite; growth ratios are diagnostics on the registered dimensions and are not an untruncated divergence theorem.
Signs are retained only inside the exact union-support group; absolute pair sums remain separately reported.
The reversed term order is rebuilt and compared matrix-wise with the negative forward group.
Each rho_U is an induced finite two-site Gibbs matrix and is not identified with an infinite-volume KMS restriction.
All four K_U^(1/2)-Gibbs legs are evaluated separately without commuting K_U through the commutator.
The source support and oscillator dimensions are exactly those in the manifest; no external bond or untruncated CCR is inserted.
Common core, cutoff removal, thermodynamic history, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
R358 checks fixture counts, exact rational growth arithmetic and the scope firewall; matrix spectra and asymptotics remain Python evidence.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite high-cutoff signed-cancellation stress only. It is not a global no-go theorem or a QFT/Clay result.

lean_crosscheck.role: R358 checks exact high-cutoff fixture/count arithmetic and finite-only scope; matrix norms, Gibbs factors, common domains and QFT limits remain Python/open analysis.

named_proxy.signed_group: S_U=sum of [H_j,H_k] with the declared term-order sign for all overlapping pairs
named_proxy.state: rho_U=exp(-beta H_U)/Tr(exp(-beta H_U)) for the induced two-site Hamiltonian
